record_transformations: Entity summaries are neutral identity descriptions; profile/loadout labels are removed rather than retaining unsupported prose.
References to excluded predecessors or entities are removed; excluded record IDs and reasons remain in this manifest.
Existing source receipt pointers are rebound to one new public selection receipt hashing retained records. Original private receipt payloads are not claimed unchanged.
Patch normalized-claim counts are recomputed for the retained subset under existing count semantics; reviewed-through patches and truth statuses are not extended.
Canonical operational policies and source events, historical imports, seeds, and personal status history are excluded.

Bulk patch-change prose, copied patch.* bullet claims, their verification strategies, and full-note completeness reviews are excluded. Patch coverage and affected entities describe only surviving source-linked facts; unused identities and stale Fandom license tags are removed.

rights_decisions.boundary: CC BY-SA 4.0; original contributors attributed by source and page history; normalized/adapted fields marked; underlying game IP excluded.
Limited normalized publisher-intent statements and locators in a free unofficial reference; no transfer or blanket commercial clearance of publisher IP.
Excluded instead of inventing permissions; any later reinstatement requires a source-backed rights decision and reviewed scope change.
rights_decisions.source_class: Unknown normalized-fact sources, inaccessible permission artifacts, and unverified Fandom cohort

selection_rules: Retain source-verified CrimsonWiki licensed facts and limited official publisher-intent facts with evidence locators.
Exclude unknown-rights normalized source records, unverifiable permission sources, and the unverified Fandom cohort; no rights label is upgraded to claim clearance.
Exclude any assertion relying on excluded evidence; locator-only evidence cannot authorize gameplay assertions.
Exclude personal preferences, personal state, custom loadout identities, and dependencies; unused sources and identities are removed.
Preserve retained record IDs, original fact statuses, patch boundaries, evidence locators, and uncertainty.
Do not expand this finite historical dataset before release except for a reviewed correction.
Exclude bulk publisher patch prose and copied patch bullets; keep only independently bounded facts and patch identities/locators. No complete official-note review survives this selection.
